rowText: Ask 'What game am I playing?' with Black Mesa running and focused; read the reply.
steps: The pinned chip kept settling on a different one of the three sentences and would not hold on this one long enough to press A after several tries.

While chasing the right chip, the Deck stopped answering over the connection this session uses to read the screen and press buttons for the plugin's own panel. A screenshot taken outside that connection shows Black Mesa's own in-game menu on screen, not the Steam overlay, and several tries in a row to reopen the panel all failed the same way.

This matches the driver's stop rule for this run (the on-screen reading connection down for more than about two minutes), so this row -- and the rest of the Black Mesa block -- stopped here rather than continuing to press blind.
verdictSentence: Could not be run: the connection this session uses to see the screen and press buttons stopped answering partway through, with Black Mesa's own menu left on screen instead of the plugin panel.
